purpose: Canonical source provenance and on-demand external export; not a build input or binary-reproducibility claim.
excludedDependencies: Full symbol databases and monolithic Black2Upgrade implementation
normalization: UTF-8 text with LF endings and a final newline; machine-specific paths are replaced with <LOCAL_PATH>. Binary PNG build inputs are copied byte-for-byte.

patches.name: cgear-quick-actions
patches.title: C-Gear Buttons and Quick Actions
patches.note: BW2 0.5.7 includes the optional System Shop picker, native Pokémart, custom inventories/prices, stackable-item currencies, native TM rendering, currency balance icon and optional per-item badge/save-flag conditions. Inventory defaults remain unrestricted, and visible stock/prices share a stable row map. BW1 remains 0.1.3-bw1 without System Shop. Both retain HM02-gated native Fly without a learned-move requirement. BW2 retains the outer-rim 12-degree skin dial and moving marker while hiding the digital clock and chevron decal; shared geometry and compiled graphics are inventoried here. It retains the optional Nuzlocke snapshot provider to the Pokenav application action; its shared viewer sources are inventoried separately. Bundle hashes/versions are tested together. Source availability does not establish hardware acceptance.

patches.name: pokenav
patches.title: BW2 Pokenav encounter browser
patches.note: Pokenav 0.3.0 is linked into the BW2 Learnset 1.8.0 companions and launched by C-Gear Quick Actions 0.5.0; it has no independent DLL. Current map/season tables, grouped species/forms, combined slot chances and a read-only information panel. Both screens share angled panels, a scrolling grid, the native toolbar selector pulse and native X/return footer art. Bounded caches and incremental rendering prioritize input feedback ahead of the preview. Version 0.3.0 adds optional gray dupe icons, normalized chances and a backward-compatible version-2 request. The existing styling includes Summary white/gray primary text, compact muted labels, shoulder-button method switching and complete-screen presentation at entry. Emulator, CPU and installer checks are distinct evidence; no live hardware acceptance is implied.

patches.name: nuzlocke-encounters

Native CPU checks, installer round trips and copied-save emulator evidence are distinct; physical hardware acceptance is not claimed.

patches.name: field-environment

patches.name: field-season

patches.name: trainer-field-conditions
patches.title: Trainer battle field conditions
patches.note: Original US revision-0 Black 2 / White 2 PMC runtimes, version 0.1.1. Opening animations are followed by native condition messages; exact 0.1.0 modules can update without losing authored settings. Permanent native conditions are set once before entry abilities; explicit removal and replacement use native battle handling. BW1 and other regions/revisions remain unavailable. Native binding audits, CPU and ROM roundtrip checks accompany DLL-hashed DS singles receipts in both games covering all 30 opening animation/message pairs, ten-turn persistence, Brick Break removal and Drought replacement; other formats have CPU checks. The Black 2 gameplay input included an existing C-Gear add-on; no separate clean Black 2 gameplay run is claimed.
